fitting.congress_116: all valid cohort and frozen population-reference Yea/Nay votes
fitting.congress_117: roll numbers 1 through 475 inclusive for the same people

candidate_selection.congress_118: all valid cohort Yea/Nay votes in time order

applicability_calibration.congress_119: first 150 valid votes per target in roll-call order; outcomes excluded from all parameter and state updates

final_comparison.congress_119: next 300 valid votes per target after applicability calibration

environment_mapping.session_two: 1 exactly when Voteview session equals 2, otherwise 0

selection_rule.metric: equal-person-weighted mean candidate-selection negative log likelihood

wrong_person_rule: within the frozen same-party cohort, closest fitting-role Yea rate, then lowest numeric person ID

controls.static_correct_person: population scenario plus correct stable person component, no environment or state
controls.environment_population: population scenario plus observable environment, no stable person or state
controls.dynamic_population: environment population plus correct target past-state updates, no stable person component
controls.wrong_person_joint: wrong same-party stable component and wrong person's own causal state history; score target only on roll calls with a valid wrong-person vote
controls.history_shuffled_joint: correct stable component; initialize final state from a SHA-256 ordering of candidate-selection outcomes, then update causally with only earlier final target outcomes
controls.full_joint: correct stable component, environment, and correct target causal state history

applicability.feature_vector: 20 scenario features concatenated with 6 environment features

uncertainty_and_aggregation.person_weighting: each of the six people receives equal weight regardless of valid intersection count
uncertainty_and_aggregation.paired_interval: cluster bootstrap over the six person-level NLL uplifts
uncertainty_and_aggregation.ece: computed once over all final target outcomes and full-joint probabilities after wrong-person intersection filtering
uncertainty_and_aggregation.wrong_person_gate: equal-person mean wrong-person NLL minus full-joint NLL must be positive
uncertainty_and_aggregation.history_shuffled_gate: equal-person mean history-shuffled NLL minus full-joint NLL must be positive
